request.style: English, deep male solo voice, celtic harp, bodhran, uilleann pipes, fiddle, flute, somber and reverent mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Shuthelah walked with his son
Bered stood in the line
Tahath kept the covenant
The blood of Ephraim divine

[Chorus]
Tahath son of Bered
Eleadah came after you
The name returns again
In the house of Joseph true

[Verse]
The son of Eleadah
Tahath once more stands
Within the tribe of Ephraim
Where the patriarchs commanded

[Chorus]
Tahath son of Bered
Eleadah came after you
The name returns again
In the house of Joseph true

[Outro]
Descendants of Ephraim
The line continues on
